page.overview:
Who is Jessep Nimblethorp?

is a teenaged sorcerer and one of the campers attending Wildemount Wildlings. She is played by Libe Barer.

Jessep is very tall (almost 6 feet), has pale blue skin, ultramarine eyes, and aquamarine hair with pale roots that has grown a bit wild. She wears a monocle.

She is intelligent and somewhat anxious. Despite having excellent health, she is hypochondriac.

Jessep grew up in a very academic household, since both her parents were professors, which made her a very good student. In 844 PD she was sent to the Wildemount Wildlings camp, and even though she had started manifesting magic, she wasn't able to control it. At one point a wild surge of energy caused many people to temporarily lose their hair, making her feel terrible about it. She and Sky became friends, and during a race in which both of them were doing pretty badly, they came up with a song that helped with the sorcerer's anxiety.
